architecture.mechanism: A longitudinal-vertical coupled dynamics model that accounts for engine harmonic torque, time-varying gear meshing stiffness, nonlinear dual-mass flywheel torsional behavior, powertrain mount deformation/torsion, tire deformation, and random road excitations to analyze DCT starting dynamics and identify sources of slow response, transmission vibration, and performance instability.
architecture.intervention: Apply the coupled longitudinal-vertical dynamics model to characterize the specific Elantra DCT starting condition under the reported low-mileage, light-load environment; identify the dominant contributor (e.g., torsional oscillation of the dual-mass flywheel, excessive engine harmonic torque transmission, or mount/powertrain compliance) causing RPM flare without proportional acceleration; then re-tune the dual-mass flywheel stiffness/damping, revise clutch pressure ramp during launch to dampen torsional oscillations, and add a controller compensation term for engine harmonic excitation during the starting phase.
architecture.expected_effect: Elimination of the RPM flare-and-slip symptom during acceleration by suppressing torsional oscillations and improving torque transfer consistency at the clutch interface, restoring smooth launch response without relying on diagnostic trouble codes or warning lights.
architecture.falsification_test: Instrument the vehicle with a crankshaft speed sensor, transmission input/output speed sensors, and a clutch position/pressure transducer; perform repeated cold-start and warm-start accelerations on a flat road. If clutch slippage (defined as input shaft speed exceeding output shaft speed scaled by gear ratio by more than 50 rpm for longer than 0.5 s) is eliminated and the standard deviation of the difference between engine torque demand and delivered wheel torque during launch is reduced by at least 50% relative to the pre-intervention baseline, the mechanism is supported; persistent slippage or torsional oscillation at the same magnitude falsifies the diagnosis and implicates another root cause.
